en.text: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫年纪老迈，日子满足，就立他儿子所罗门作以色列的王。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛年紀老邁，日子滿足，就立他兒子所羅門作以色列的王。

en.text: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫招聚以色列的众首领和祭司利未人。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛招聚以色列的眾首領和祭司利未人。

en.text: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

zhSimplified.text: 利未人从三十岁以外的都被数点，他们男丁的数目共有三万八千；

zhTraditional.text: 利未人從三十歲以外的都被數點，他們男丁的數目共有三萬八千；

en.text: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the LORD’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,

zhSimplified.text: 其中有二万四千人管理耶和华殿的事，有六千人作官长和士师，

zhTraditional.text: 其中有二萬四千人管理耶和華殿的事，有六千人作官長和士師，

en.text: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”

zhSimplified.text: 有四千人作守门的，又有四千人用大卫所做的乐器颂赞耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 有四千人作守門的，又有四千人用大衛所做的樂器頌讚耶和華。

en.text: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫将利未人革顺、哥辖、米拉利的子孙分了班次。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛將利未人革順、哥轄、米拉利的子孫分了班次。

en.text: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

zhSimplified.text: 革顺的子孙有拉但和示每。

zhTraditional.text: 革順的子孫有拉但和示每。

en.text: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.

zhSimplified.text: 拉但的长子是耶歇，还有细坦和约珥，共三人。

zhTraditional.text: 拉但的長子是耶歇，還有細坦和約珥，共三人。

en.text: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.

zhSimplified.text: 示每的儿子是示罗密、哈薛、哈兰三人。这是拉但族的族长。

zhTraditional.text: 示每的兒子是示羅密、哈薛、哈蘭三人。這是拉但族的族長。

en.text: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

zhSimplified.text: 示每的儿子是雅哈、细拿、耶乌施、比利亚共四人。

zhTraditional.text: 示每的兒子是雅哈、細拿、耶烏施、比利亞共四人。

en.text: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.

zhSimplified.text: 雅哈是长子，细撒是次子。但耶乌施和比利亚的子孙不多，所以算为一族。

zhTraditional.text: 雅哈是長子，細撒是次子。但耶烏施和比利亞的子孫不多，所以算為一族。

en.text: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

zhSimplified.text: 哥辖的儿子是暗兰、以斯哈、希伯伦、乌薛共四人。

zhTraditional.text: 哥轄的兒子是暗蘭、以斯哈、希伯倫、烏薛共四人。

en.text: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.

zhSimplified.text: 暗兰的儿子是亚伦、摩西。亚伦和他的子孙分出来，好分别至圣的物，在耶和华面前烧香、事奉他，奉他的名祝福，直到永远。

zhTraditional.text: 暗蘭的兒子是亞倫、摩西。亞倫和他的子孫分出來，好分別至聖的物，在耶和華面前燒香、事奉他，奉他的名祝福，直到永遠。

en.text: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.

zhSimplified.text: 至于神人摩西，他的子孙名字记在利未支派的册上。

zhTraditional.text: 至於神人摩西，他的子孫名字記在利未支派的冊上。

en.text: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西的儿子是革舜和以利以谢。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西的兒子是革舜和以利以謝。

en.text: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

zhSimplified.text: 革舜的长子是细布业；

zhTraditional.text: 革舜的長子是細布業；

en.text: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

zhSimplified.text: 以利以谢的儿子是利哈比雅。以利以谢没有别的儿子，但利哈比雅的子孙甚多。

zhTraditional.text: 以利以謝的兒子是利哈比雅。以利以謝沒有別的兒子，但利哈比雅的子孫甚多。

en.text: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

zhSimplified.text: 以斯哈的长子是示罗密。

zhTraditional.text: 以斯哈的長子是示羅密。

en.text: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

zhSimplified.text: 希伯伦的长子是耶利雅，次子是亚玛利亚，三子是雅哈悉，四子是耶加面。

zhTraditional.text: 希伯倫的長子是耶利雅，次子是亞瑪利亞，三子是雅哈悉，四子是耶加面。

en.text: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.

zhSimplified.text: 乌薛的长子是米迦，次子是耶西雅。

zhTraditional.text: 烏薛的長子是米迦，次子是耶西雅。

en.text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

zhSimplified.text: 米拉利的儿子是抹利、母示。抹利的儿子是以利亚撒、基士。

zhTraditional.text: 米拉利的兒子是抹利、母示。抹利的兒子是以利亞撒、基士。

en.text: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.

zhSimplified.text: 以利亚撒死了，没有儿子，只有女儿，他们本族基士的儿子娶了她们为妻。

zhTraditional.text: 以利亞撒死了，沒有兒子，只有女兒，他們本族基士的兒子娶了她們為妻。

en.text: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

zhSimplified.text: 母示的儿子是末力、以得、耶利摩共三人。

zhTraditional.text: 母示的兒子是末力、以得、耶利摩共三人。

en.text: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the LORD’s house, from twenty years old and upward.

zhSimplified.text: 以上利未子孙作族长的，照着男丁的数目，从二十岁以外，都办耶和华殿的事务。

zhTraditional.text: 以上利未子孫作族長的，照着男丁的數目，從二十歲以外，都辦耶和華殿的事務。

en.text: For David said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫说：「耶和华—以色列的 神已经使他的百姓平安，他永远住在耶路撒冷。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛說：「耶和華－以色列的上帝已經使他的百姓平安，他永遠住在耶路撒冷。

en.text: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”

zhSimplified.text: 利未人不必再抬帐幕和其中所用的一切器皿了。」

zhTraditional.text: 利未人不必再抬帳幕和其中所用的一切器皿了。」

en.text: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.

zhSimplified.text: 照着大卫临终所吩咐的，利未人从二十岁以外的都被数点。

zhTraditional.text: 照着大衛臨終所吩咐的，利未人從二十歲以外的都被數點。

en.text: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the LORD’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;

zhSimplified.text: 他们的职任是服事亚伦的子孙，在耶和华的殿和院子，并屋中办事，洁净一切圣物，就是办 神殿的事务，

zhTraditional.text: 他們的職任是服事亞倫的子孫，在耶和華的殿和院子，並屋中辦事，潔淨一切聖物，就是辦上帝殿的事務，

en.text: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;

zhSimplified.text: 并管理陈设饼，素祭的细面，或无酵薄饼，或用盘烤，或用油调和的物，又管理各样的升斗尺度；

zhTraditional.text: 並管理陳設餅，素祭的細麵，或無酵薄餅，或用盤烤，或用油調和的物，又管理各樣的升斗尺度；

en.text: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise in the evening;

zhSimplified.text: 每日早晚，站立称谢赞美耶和华，

zhTraditional.text: 每日早晚，站立稱謝讚美耶和華，

en.text: and to offer all burnt offerings to the LORD on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before the LORD;

zhSimplified.text: 又在安息日、月朔，并节期，按数照例，将燔祭常常献给耶和华；

zhTraditional.text: 又在安息日、月朔，並節期，按數照例，將燔祭常常獻給耶和華；

en.text: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of the LORD’s house.

zhSimplified.text: 又看守会幕和圣所，并守耶和华吩咐他们弟兄亚伦子孙的，办耶和华殿的事。

zhTraditional.text: 又看守會幕和聖所，並守耶和華吩咐他們弟兄亞倫子孫的，辦耶和華殿的事。
